photos.desc: Artist's impression of how a juvenile Sciurumimus would have appeared.
The "squirrel mimic" Sciurumimus , a juvenile coelurosaurian theropod dinosaur from the Late Jurassic of lower Bavaria, Germany.
Fossil theropod (gen. nov. sp. nov.) from the plattenkalk of Peinten, Germany.
Took the picture at Burgmeister Muller Museum, Solnhofen
